name: Ken Martin

lean.basis: Chair of the Minnesota DFL (2011–2025) and of the Democratic National Committee since 2025.

current_role: Chair of the Democratic National Committee (since February 2025)
summary: Ken Martin has chaired the Democratic National Committee since February 1, 2025, when he won the first ballot with about 246 votes to Ben Wikler's 134 after the party's 2024 defeat. He previously led Minnesota's Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party for 14 years, was a DNC vice chair and president of the Association of State Democratic Committees.
